title: Login request times out after submitting valid credentials
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in ShopPortal, the user encountered: Login request times out after submitting valid credentials.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Welcome back
2. Observe UI state: Signing in...
3. Observe UI state: Request timed out

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Request timed out.

## Environment
- App: ShopPortal
- Platform: web
